description: This file defines the SessionKey enum with static methods for generating and validating session key strings related to agent sessions.

methods.name: normalizeMainKey
methods.description: Normalizes a raw session key string, defaulting to 'main' if input is nil or empty.

methods.name: makeAgentSessionKey
methods.description: Creates a session key string for an agent given an agentId and baseKey, ensuring proper trimming and defaulting to 'main' where appropriate.

methods.name: isCanonicalMainSessionKey
methods.description: Checks if a given session key string is a canonical main session key (either 'global' or an agent session).
